name: 6grupa-vs-5g-mobility
title: 6G-RUPA vs 5G under Mobility — Reproducibility Dataset
description: Multi-country handover, roaming, federation and terrestrial/non-terrestrial evaluation: real base-station fields from six countries and four sources, official small-area population layers, derived two-tier UPF/PSA deployments, and per-scenario core forwarding-state churn, per-event signaling cost (sigma) and anchor path-stretch (rho) metrics for 5G against 6G-RUPA.

sources.title: ANFR, donnees sur les installations radioelectriques de plus de 5 watts
ISED Terrestrial Spectrum Licence Site Data Extract
INEGI, Censo de Poblacion y Vivienda 2020

resources.name: national-sweep
resources.description: Intra-PLMN evaluation. 27 targets (country x base-station field x operator) times three mobility profiles, 81 rows. 1200 s, scale factor 1000, agents = population x 0.82 / 1000. Output of PLMN-GraphSim runs/national_sweep.jl.

fields.name: country
fields.description: spain | portugal | france | canada | mexico | usa

fields.description: base-station source: opencellid | anfr | ised | fcc-asr

fields.description: real operator label

fields.description: base stations retained for this operator after the country-boundary filter

fields.name: edge_upf
fields.description: edge UL-CL UPF count (second-level admin units above 50k inhabitants)

fields.name: psa
fields.description: centralized PSA (anchor) count, round(pop/10M) clamped to [2,5]

fields.name: agents
fields.description: population-derived mobile agents; one agent represents 1000 subscribers

fields.description: depth-1 share: target gNB under the same edge UPF

fields.name: l2_n2_pct
fields.description: depth-2 share: edge UPF changes, anchor pinned

fields.name: psa_region_crossings
fields.description: geometric anchor-region crossings; priced at depth 3 but never triggered under SSC mode 1

fields.name: sigma_5g_bytes
fields.description: cumulative 5G control signaling

fields.name: sigma_6grupa_bytes
fields.description: cumulative 6G-RUPA control signaling (flat 200 B per event)

fields.name: sigma_advantage_pct
fields.description: 100 x (1 - sigma_6grupa/sigma_5g)

fields.name: core_writes_5g
fields.description: cumulative core forwarding-state writes, O(n) in sessions

fields.name: core_writes_6grupa
fields.description: always 0: no handover changes the core prefix set

fields.name: anchor_dist_5g_km
fields.description: mean serving edge to pinned anchor (5G hairpin)

fields.name: anchor_dist_opt_km
fields.description: mean serving edge to nearest anchor (local egress)

fields.name: stretch_excess_km
fields.description: rho: anchor-induced path-length excess

resources.name: anchor-sweep
resources.description: Anchor-count sensitivity. Six countries x five anchor counts (2, 5, 10, 20, 40) x two mobility profiles, 60 rows. Tests that sigma and the core-write columns are insensitive to the anchor count, which is fixed elsewhere by a clamped rule, while rho falls monotonically as anchors are added. The anchor set is re-clustered for every count, so each row is a genuine redeployment. Output of PLMN-GraphSim runs/anchor_sweep.jl.

fields.name: edge_upf
fields.description: held fixed at the country's national partition

fields.name: psa
fields.description: swept anchor count

fields.name: mobility_model
fields.description: pedestrian | highway

resources.name: federation-continental
resources.description: Two independent continental federations, each grown country-first from K=2 to K=6, under both 5G border semantics and three mobility profiles: 60 rows over 749,121 base stations. Europe: Movistar ES, MEO PT, Orange FR, Vodafone ES, NOS PT, SFR FR. North America: Verizon US, Telus CA, Telcel MX, AT&T US, Rogers CA, Movistar MX. Members are contiguous on the ground, because an inter-member crossing has to be reachable. Output of PLMN-GraphSim runs/federation_continental.jl.

fields.name: federation
fields.description: europe | north_america

fields.name: members
fields.description: pipe-separated member list at this K

fields.name: K
fields.description: federation size

fields.name: bilateral_agreements
fields.description: 5G roaming mesh size K(K-1)/2, of six configured artifacts each

fields.name: rupa_enrollments
fields.description: 6G-RUPA internetwork-layer enrollments, O(K)

fields.name: semantics
fields.description: reestablish (deployed behaviour: a crossing re-establishes the PDU session) | ideal_ho (a seamless cross-border handover that no clause defines)

fields.name: roam_entries
fields.description: inter-member crossings

fields.name: crossings_per_agent_hr
fields.description: the federation-viability rate

fields.name: intra_sigma_adv_pct
fields.description: within-member advantage, expected to stay at the national band

fields.name: roam_sigma_adv_pct
fields.description: per-crossing advantage

fields.name: session_breaks_5g
fields.description: scaled; zero under ideal_ho and always zero for 6G-RUPA

fields.name: roam_path_5g_km
fields.description: mean hairpin: serving edge abroad to home anchor

fields.name: roam_path_opt_km
fields.description: mean nearest-anchor egress

fields.name: roam_excess_km
fields.description: rho at the member border

resources.name: ntn-sweep
resources.description: Terrestrial/non-terrestrial composition. The Starlink 550 km shell is run against nine national fields in turn, because how often a user falls off terrestrial coverage is a property of the country and of the field's granularity, not of the constellation: 9 targets x 4 terrestrial-range thresholds x 3 mobility profiles x 2 satellite-handover semantics, 216 rows. SGP4 propagation, one-second shared snapshots, 25 degree minimum elevation, 50k agent cap so every country costs the same and the satellite-served fraction stays a per-agent statistic. Output of PLMN-GraphSim runs/ntn_sweep.jl.

fields.name: r_terr_km
fields.description: maximum modeled terrestrial coverage radius; beyond it an agent attaches to the satellite member

fields.name: mobility_model
fields.description: stationary | pedestrian | highway

fields.name: satellite_ho_semantics
fields.description: xn | n2 endpoint of the serving-satellite handover sensitivity

fields.name: satellite_served_pct
fields.description: share of agent ticks served by the NTN member

fields.name: outage_pct
fields.description: share with neither terrestrial nor qualifying satellite service

fields.name: ntn_attach_events
fields.description: terrestrial to satellite crossings

fields.name: ntn_return_events
fields.description: satellite to terrestrial crossings

fields.name: satellite_handovers
fields.description: serving-satellite changes inside the NTN member; these occur without user motion because the network moves

fields.name: session_breaks_5g
fields.description: scaled breaks at terrestrial/NTN crossings

fields.name: terrestrial_advantage_pct
fields.description: within-country advantage, reported to show the constellation does not perturb it

resources.name: churn-data-verizon-1200
resources.description: Core forwarding-state churn against active users, the headline figure. Verizon OpenCellID field, 817 edge UPFs, 5 anchors, 120 km/h Gauss-Markov, full 1200 s, scale factor 1000, paired seeds per population point. Output of PLMN-GraphSim runs/churn_data_usa.jl.

fields.name: users
fields.description: agents x 1000 represented subscribers

resources.name: churn-data-usa
resources.description: Source check for the headline churn figure: the same sweep run on both US fields, Verizon OpenCellID and FCC ASR, at 300 s. Confirms the linear growth is not a property of one field.
